name: dth-pc
title: Digital Transformation Handbook for Health Product Catalogue

directories.description: The working document of the DTH for health product catalogue: its document, chapters and blocks, seeded from the L1 entry who-iris/library/9789240116191-eng by its contents-page outline.

The handbook's own product catalogue terms (Product Master Data, Generic Product, Trade Item, Regulated Trade Item, Catalogue Manager, …) as a folio-glossary/v1 SKOS scheme. Each term quotes the handbook with its L1 page and links to the dth-sc or smart-ra concept it narrows or matches. Supply chain terms are held in dth-sc, general digital terms in smart-ra.
Inbox for material not yet ingested.
This instance's work plan — one Markdown file per bean, managed with the `beans` CLI (`.beans.yml`).
People's outstanding items and the feedback raised against blocks; its inner directories are declared by `todos/todos.json`.

description: WHO Digital transformation handbook for health product catalogue (ISBN 9789240116191), as an L2 DTH on smart-ra and dth-sc: the working document folio seeded from its L1 entry in who-iris, and its product catalogue glossary linked to the dth-sc and smart-ra glossaries and the smart-ra ArchiMate model.
_needs_comment: An L2 DTH on smart-ra and dth-sc (owner, 2026-10-31, option A; dth-hrh#47, dth-pc#2): its glossary terms, narrative, roles, processes and decision tables link to dpi-h-ra (litlfred/smart-ra) and dth-sc (litlfred/dth-sc) glossary concepts and ArchiMate 0.3.0-draft.1 elements and views (smart-ra#147). smart-base stays, because the DAK block kinds (persona, businessProcess, decisionTable) reach this folio through smart-base content-adapters/dak.json.
